    Design.peeringIntelligence()
    Begins a peering-intelligence request, resolving the PeeringDB credential the same way Fabric.peeringIntelligence() does: the EquinixConfig.peeringDbApiKey option configured on the underlying client (if this facade wraps a Fabric), else the PEERINGDB_API_KEY environment variable, else anonymous access.
